entities.summary: Oluwatoyosi Ogunseye is a Nigerian journalist, and as of August 2023, the President & CEO of the Presidential Precinct. She formerly served as the head of language services at BBC World Service and was the first female Sunday editor of The Punch Newspaper. She is also a 2014 Mandela Washington Fellowship Alumna, having completed her Fellowship at the Presidential Precinct.
